question: Which of the following expressions has a positive result?
solution: The product of 2 numbers with the same sign is positive: \((-2)\times(-3)=6\). In \((-2)\times3\) and \(2\times(-3)\), the factors have opposite signs, so the products are negative. Also, \(0\times(-3)=0\).
